__broaden__.κ: κε(ν) (elided κ’) — epic particle marking a conditioned or potential action (= Attic ἄν) · also εἰ … κ’ + subj. in a condition: ’if … should’ · also ἐπεί κ’ + aor. subj., prospective temporal: ’when, once’ · also εἰς ὅ κ’ + opt., ’until … should’ · also κ’ + opt., potential: ’would’ (οὐδέ κ’ … ὀνόσαιτ’ ’nor would … make light of’) · also εἴ … κ’ + fut. indic. in a condition: ’if … shall’ (εἴ κ’ … ἑλκήσουσιν ’if … drag’) · also κ’ + aor. indic., past potential: ’would have’ (ἦ κ’ ἐδάμην ’I would have been subdued’)

__broaden__.κορυθαίολος: κορυθαίολος — with glancing, flashing helmet; masc. nom. sg., stock epithet of Hector · also masc. nom. sg., epithet of Ares

__broaden__.νέμονται: νέμω — mid. graze, feed on, range over; pres. 3 pl. mid.: ’they graze’ · also pres. 3 pl. mid., ’inhabit, dwell in’ (ἄλσεα νέμονται ’inhabit groves’)
__broaden__.σύμβαλον: συμβάλλω — throw together, clash; aor. 3 pl. act., unaugmented, epic (= Attic συνέβαλον): ’clashed, came together’ · also transitive, with an acc. object: ’they threw together, set against one another’ (τοὺς … σύμβαλον ’threw them together’)
__broaden__.σῶκος: Σῶκος — Socus, a Trojan, son of Hippasus; masc. nom. sg., proper name · also σῶκος — sturdy, strong (an epithet of Hermes; sense traditional); masc. nom. sg., a common adjective
__broaden__.τοῖσι: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he, she, it; that (in Homer a pronoun; later the article); masc. dat. pl. ’to/among them’ · also with ἅμα, of company: ’with them’ (ἅμα τοῖσι ’along with them’)
__broaden__.ἀκροτάτης: ἄκρος — topmost, highest; superl. ἀκρότατος, fem. gen. sg., agreeing with κόρυθος: ’the very top (of the helmet)’ · also fem. gen. sg., agreeing with πόλιος: ’topmost’ (κατ’ ἀκροτάτης πόλιος ’down from the top of the city’)

__broaden__.ἐναίρειν: ἐναίρω — kill, slay; pres. inf. act., epexegetic after an adjective: ’to slay’ · also pres. inf. after a verb of ordering: ’to slay’ (ἐκέλευεν … ἐναίρειν ’was ordering … to slay’)
__broaden__.ἐναντίον: ἐναντίος — opposite; neut. acc. sg. as adv./prep. + gen.: ’in front of, before’ · also + gen., ’against’, of a hostile meeting (Ἀχιλῆος ἐναντίον μάχεσθαι ’to fight against Achilles’)
__broaden__.ἐπὶ: ἐπί — on, upon, to, against; + dat./acc./gen.; also a preverb in tmesis (ἐπὶ … ἔτελλε = ἐπέτελλε) · also + dat., ’in aid of, on behalf of’ (ἐπὶ Τρώεσσιν ἀρῆξαι ’to help the Trojans’) · also + acc. of duration, ’for’ (ἐπὶ χρόνον ’for a time’) · also + acc. of extent, ’over, along’ (ἐπὶ νῶτον ’along the back’) · also + acc. of the thing aimed at, ’for’ (ἐπὶ τεύχεα ’for the armour’) · also + gen., ’toward’ (μελαινάων ἐπὶ νηῶν ’toward the black ships’) · also + gen. of time, ’in the time of’ (ἐπὶ προτέρων ἀνθρώπων ’in the time of earlier men’) · also adv., ’next, after’ (ἐπὶ δὲ πλήξιππον Ὀρέστην ’and next Orestes’) · also adv., ’besides, in addition’ (ἐπὶ δὲ … ὅρκον ὀμοῦμαι ’besides, I shall swear an oath’) · also adv., ’on it, upon it’ (ἐπὶ … ζυγὸν ἦεν ’there was a yoke upon it’) · also + dat. of time: ’for, during’ (ἐπὶ νυκτί ’for the night’) · also + dat., ’over, for’ (ἐπὶ κτεάτεσσι ’over possessions’) · also + gen., ’for’ (ἐπὶ δώρων ’for the gifts’; force uncertain) · also + dat. of place: ’at’ (ἐπὶ τάφρῳ ’at the ditch’) · also ἐπὶ ἶσα, adverbial: ’equally, evenly’ · also + a φιν-form of place: ’on the (right) side’ (ἐπὶ δεξιόφιν ’on the right’) · also + dat. of respect: ’in’ (ἐπὶ φρεσὶ … κέκασται ’excels in wits’)
